SELECT s.id AS id, s.applied_at AS applied_at, owner.nickname AS user_nickname, s.name AS name, s.status AS status, handler.nickname AS handler_name, s.reviewed_at AS handled_at FROM spots s LEFT JOIN users owner ON owner.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN users handler ON handler.id = s.reviewer_id
ORDER BY CASE s.status WHEN 'V' THEN 0 WHEN 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN s.status IN ('V', 'P') THEN s.applied_at END ASC, CASE WHEN s.status IN ('B', 'R') THEN s.reviewed_at END DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spots s LEFT JOIN users owner ON owner.id = s.user_id
